arxiv-2010-01406.title: Event-shaped-dependent cumulants in p-Pb collisions at 5.02 TeV
arxiv-2010-01406.creator: De-Xian Wei, Li-Juan Zhou
arxiv-2010-01406.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by De-Xian Wei, Li-Juan Zhou. In this paper, we present a novel event-shaped cumulants (ESC) response approach, based on a multi-phase transport (AMPT) model simulations, to analyze p-Pb collisions at s N ​ N \sqrt{s_{NN}} = 5.02 TeV.

arxiv-2109-15039.title: On soft gluon resummation for associated single top production with a Higgs boson at the LHC
arxiv-2109-15039.description: Abstract We investigate threshold resummation of soft gluon corrections for the s s -channel process of a single top quark production in association with a Higgs boson in the Standard Model. We choose to work in the three-particle invariant mass kinematics in direct QCD, i.e. in the space of Mellin moments.

arxiv-2110-09348.title: Understanding Dimensional Collapse in Contrastive Self-supervised Learning
arxiv-2110-09348.creator: Li Jing, Pascal Vincent, Yann LeCun, Yuandong Tian
arxiv-2110-09348.description: Abstract Self-supervised visual representation learning aims to learn useful representations without relying on human annotations. Joint embedding approach bases on maximizing the agreement between embedding vectors from different views of the same image. Various methods have been proposed to solve the collapsing problem where all embedding vectors collapse to a trivial constant solution.

arxiv-2206-04749.title: A Combinatorial Tale of Two Scattering Amplitudes: See Two Bijections
arxiv-2206-04749.creator: Simeng Simone Hu
arxiv-2206-04749.description: Abstract A thesis presented to the University of Waterloo in fulfillment of the thesis requirement for the degree of Master of Mathematics in Combinatorics and Optimization Waterloo, Ontario, Canada, 2021 ©Simeng Simone Hu 2021 Author’s declaration I hereby declare that I am the sole author of this thesis.

arxiv-2305-05317.title: Minimal Linear Codes Constructed from hierarchical posets with two levels
arxiv-2305-05317.creator: Xia Wu
arxiv-2305-05317.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xia Wu. Codes Cryptogr., vol. 2475-2492, 2020) constructed some optimal and minimal binary linear codes generated by one or two order ideals in hierarchical posets of two levels. At the end of their paper, they left an open problem: it also should be interesting to investigate the cases of more than two orders in hierarchical posets with two levels or many levels.

arxiv-2506-16891.title: Tracker Installations Are Not Created Equal: Understanding Tracker Configuration of Form Data Collection Volume: YYYY X DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX
arxiv-2506-16891.creator: Julia B. Kieserman, Athanasios Andreou, Chris Geeng, Tobias Lauinger, Damon McCoy
arxiv-2506-16891.description: Abstract . Targeted advertising is fueled by the comprehensive tracking of users’ online activity. As a result, advertising companies, such as Google and Meta, encourage website administrators to not only install tracking scripts on their websites but configure them to automatically collect users’ Personally Identifying Information (PII).

arxiv-2508-19676.title: Dynamic Delegation with Reputation Feedback Thanks: We thank Costas Cavounidis, Olivier Gossner, Margarita Kirneva, Yukio Koriyama, Chiara Margaria, Harry Pei, Ludvig Sinander, Francesco Squintani, Bruno Strulovici, Stepan Svistunov, Nikhil Vellodi, Maria Ziskelevich, and all the participants of the
arxiv-2508-19676.creator: Georgy Lukyanov, Anna Vlasova
arxiv-2508-19676.description: Abstract We study dynamic delegation with reputation feedback : a long-lived expert advises a sequence of implementers whose effort responds to current reputation, altering outcome informativeness and belief updates. We solve for a recursive, belief-based equilibrium and show that advice is a reputation-dependent cutoff in the expert’s signal.

arxiv-2512-20509.title: Holographic entanglement negativity and thermodynamics in backreacted AdS black hole
arxiv-2512-20509.description: Abstract We investigate holographic entanglement negativity (HEN) as a probe of mixed state quantum correlations in a deformed AdS black hole background with backreaction sourced by a string cloud. The bulk geometry is dual to a strongly coupled large- N c N_{c} gauge theory at finite temperature, backreacted by a finite density of heavy static fundamental quarks.

arxiv-2601-06490.title: Bi-Mem: Bidirectional Construction of Hierarchical Memory for Personalized LLMs via Inductive-Reflective Agents
arxiv-2601-06490.creator: Wenyu Mao, Haosong Tan Shuchang Liu Haoyang Liu, Yifan Xu, Huaxiang Ji, Xiang Wang
arxiv-2601-06490.description: Abstract Constructing memory from users’ long-term conversations overcomes LLMs’ contextual limitations and enables personalized interactions. Recent studies focus on hierarchical memory to model users’ multi-granular behavioral patterns via clustering and aggregating historical conversations. However, conversational noise and memory hallucinations can be amplified during clustering, causing locally aggregated memories to misalign with the user’s global persona.

britannica-1911-whethamstede-john.title: Whethamstede, John (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-whethamstede-john.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-whethamstede-john.description: Article 'Whethamstede, John' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 28), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. College, Oxford, with which he was connected. He was a friend of Duke Humphrey of Gloucester, whom he helped to gather together his famous collection of books, and was himself a writer, his works including Granarium de viris illustribus; Palearium poetarum, and Super Valerium in Augustinum de Anchona.

pmc-10643665.title: Dual-color space network with global priors for photo retouching
pmc-10643665.creator: Pilseo Park, Heungmin Oh, Hyuncheol Kim
pmc-10643665.description: There have been growing trends using deep learning-based approaches for photo retouching which aims to enhance unattractive images and make them visually appealing. However, the existing methods only considered the RGB color space, which limited the available color information for editing.

pmc-10653318.title: A novel deep learning model for glioma epilepsy associated with the identification of human cytomegalovirus infection injuries based on head MR
pmc-10653318.creator: Wei Wang, Xuanyi Li, Lou Ye, Jian Yin
pmc-10653318.description: PurposeIn this study, a deep learning model was established based on head MRI to predict a crucial evaluation parameter in the assessment of injuries resulting from human cytomegalovirus infection: the occurrence of glioma-related epilepsy. The relationship between glioma and epilepsy was investigated, which serves as a significant indicator of labor force impairment.

pmc-11387421.title: CD71 expressing circulating neutrophils serve as a novel prognostic biomarker for metastatic spread and reduced outcome in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma patients
pmc-11387421.creator: Frederik J. Hansen, Anke Mittelstädt, Finn-Niklas Clausen, Samuel Knoedler, Leonard Knoedler, Sebastian Klöckner, Isabelle Kuchenreuther, Johanne Mazurie, Lisa-Sophie Arnold, Anna Anthuber, Anne Jacobsen, Susanne Merkel, Nadine Weisel, Bettina Klösch, Alara Karabiber, Irem Tacyildiz, Franziska Czuba
pmc-11387421.description: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is one of the most lethal malignancies, presenting a persisting global health burden. Neutrophils have a double-edged role in tumor progression exhibiting both pro-tumor and anti-tumor functions. CD71, also known as transferrin receptor 1, performs a critical role in cellular iron uptake and is highly expressed on proliferating cells, and especially on activated immune cells.

pmc-11454594.title: 12509 Identification Of Novel Exercise Training-induced Circulating Proteins: Hemostatic, Apoptotic, And Key Neuronal Factors
pmc-11454594.creator: Almog Shalit, Maria Vamvini, Pasquale Nigro, Laura K Simpson, Hui Pan, Jonathan M Dreyfuss, Laurie J Goodyear, Roeland J W Middelbeek
pmc-11454594.description: Disclosure: A. Shalit: None. M. Vamvini: None. P. Nigro: None. L.K. Simpson: None. H. Pan: None. J.M. Dreyfuss: None. L.J. Goodyear: Grant Recipient; Self; Daiichi Sankyo. R.J. Middelbeek: None.Exercise training induces a plethora of health benefits including improved glucose homeostasis, decreased cardiovascular disease, and improved cognitive function.

pmc-11932382.title: PREVALENCE AND RISK FACTORS OF PRESENTEEISM DURING THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC IN KOREA: ANALYSIS OF POPULATION-BASED PANEL DATA
pmc-11932382.creator: Inmyung Song
pmc-11932382.description: Objectives:Defined as attending work while ill, presenteeism is highly prevalent and has negative consequences such as reduced productivity and lower well-being for workers. This study aims to estimate the prevalence of presenteeism among Korean workers during the COVID-19 pandemic and identify the risk factors.

pmc-12716309.title: Hypophosphatemia in suspected seizures evaluated in first seizure clinics and neurology consults
pmc-12716309.creator: Sophie N. M. Binks, Daniil Zorkin, Bernard Liem, Arjune Sen
pmc-12716309.description: Transient loss of consciousness (TLoC) is a leading cause of referrals to acute neurological services. A witness account is often lacking, and ancillary investigations are a critical diagnostic adjunct. Hypophosphatemia was recently identified as a potential marker of epileptic seizures in ward and emergency department presentations.

pmc-12986782.title: From hidden springs to endless oceans: exploring the complementary roles of the amygdala and hippocampus in phenomenal experience
pmc-12986782.creator: Ronald Sladky
pmc-12986782.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Current theories of consciousness often emphasize its ego-centric functions, highlighting the role of the insular cortex in interoceptive self-modeling and subcortical brain regions in qualitative experience and motivation, aptly described as the ‘hidden spring’ of consciousness. From ecological and pragmatic perspectives, conscious experience may facilitate the self-organization of complex organisms by optimizing goals that are typically parallel, multifaceted, and difficult to reconcile.

pmc-13154995.title: Structure-driven function of plant lncRNAs: conserved RNA architectures in transcriptional and post-transcriptional regulation
pmc-13154995.creator: Yanqi Shen, Qianli Dong, Yiliang Ding, Huakun Zhang
pmc-13154995.description: Long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) have emerged as critical regulators of plant development, physiology, and environmental stress adaptation. Despite exhibiting limited primary sequence conservation across the plant kingdom, emerging evidence underscores that plant lncRNA functionality is encoded at the level of RNA secondary structure, facilitating diverse modes of structure-mediated gene regulation.

pmc-13173880.title: Association of glucose metabolism with advanced cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome and prediction model development in type 2 diabetes mellitus
pmc-13173880.creator: Qi Sun, Xinyi Yan, Xiaofeng Li, Yilun Lu, Dongqin Wei, Hai Zhang, Caoxu Zhang, Yu Shi, Yunjuan Gu
pmc-13173880.description: BackgroundCardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic (CKM) syndrome, characterized by progressive dysfunction of the cardiovascular, renal, and metabolic systems, has gained increasing recognition in recent years. However, the relationship between glucose metabolism and advanced CKM stages in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) remains insufficiently explored.

pmc-13365953.title: IFPHOR0208 Gender- and Generation-Related Vulnerability to Health Misinformation in France: Findings from a White Paper and a National Survey on Women’s Health Conducted by Civil Society Using Multiple Methods (2025)
pmc-13365953.creator: Catherine Bertrand-Ferrandis, Anne-Marie Pernet, Juliette Hazart, Danielle Nommay, Raphaëlle Genin Martin, Imène Kaci, Agnès Dessaigne, Camille Le Fur, Jessica Leygues, Micheline Misrahi-Abadou, Camille Boivigny
pmc-13365953.description: Health misinformation significantly affects women, who actively seek health information and play a leading role in managing health within families. The gender-related dimensions of vulnerability to the infodemic remain understudied.In 2015, 17 women from the Femmes de Santé Collective, a French civil society organisation, undertook a voluntary initiative to produce a white paper focused on health misinformation and women health.

pmc-13679748.title: Internal herniation through Petersen’s defect following Roux-en-Y gastric bypass presenting as subacute bilateral lower extremity edema due to IVC compression – a case report
pmc-13679748.creator: Reese Bryan, Stephanie Garcia, Zhamak Khorgami
pmc-13679748.description: A 38-year-old woman with a history of Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB) 2 years prior presented to the bariatric clinic on multiple occasions with postprandial abdominal pain and bloating and bilateral lower extremity edema. Abdominal pain did not improve despite antiacid medication and dietary recommendations.

uslaw-usc-t46-s57520.title: 46 U.S.C. § 57520 — Vessel maintenance
uslaw-usc-t46-s57520.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s57520.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Part F (Government-Owned Merchant Vessels); Chapter 575 (Construction, Charter, And Sale Of Vessels); Subchapter II (Charters). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In General.— A charter under this chapter shall require the charterer, at the charterer’s expense, to— (1) keep the chartered vessel in good repair and efficient operating condition; and (2) make any repairs required.
